subject: Question about client call time
text: Could you confirm whether you can join the client call at 1:00 p.m. instead of 3:30 p.m.? The venue changed its room at short notice, so the vendor team now needs to present earlier, and I want to make sure we are not caught off guard. I understand this may affect your other commitments, especially with the report due this afternoon. If moving the call creates a conflict, please tell me as soon as you can, ideally before noon, so I can contact the external partner and suggest another window. It would also help to know if you need a copy of the updated slides in advance. I appreciate your quick response.
